implementation: Established typed SLO measurement windows and alerts, a concurrency-safe capacity controller with critical reserves/backpressure/rate limiting, a concurrency-safe dependency circuit breaker, fail-closed RPO/RTO recovery contracts, executable control/PITR drills, and the V5-010 operations runbook.

tests.v5_regression: uv run pytest -q tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py tests/contract/test_v5_007_governance_steward.py tests/contract/test_v5_008_model_evaluation_pipeline.py tests/contract/test_v5_009_offline_rl_research.py tests/contract/test_v5_010_operational_reliability.py
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy over 170 source files, audited secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 20 property, 918 contract, and health passed

drills.control_drills: control-drills-2026-09-11.json: PASS; 7/7 SLO breaches alerted, 48 background slots stopped at the critical reserve, 16 protection slots remained available, backlog shedding/rate limiting/circuit recovery passed.
drills.postgresql_pitr: postgresql-pitr-drill-2026-09-11.json: PASS on isolated PostgreSQL 17.11; full migration plus base backup/WAL archive restored the target command and excluded the post-target command; observed RPO 0 seconds and RTO 0.15122183365747333 seconds; restored mode PROTECT_ONLY.
drills.non_empty_business_recovery: V2 fault/replay contract tests restore file-backed orders, fills, protection and append-only accounting state and verify replay reconciliation; these tests prevent extrapolating the PITR drill's explicit EMPTY_TRADING_STATE scope.

acceptance_mapping.slo_measurement_and_alerts: Seven critical objectives bind typed MetricSample windows, nearest-rank percentile or maximum thresholds, minimum sample counts, runbook references and impact scopes; insufficient and breached windows alert.
acceptance_mapping.capacity_backpressure_rate_limit: A versioned single-host profile enforces per-workload in-flight/backlog/rate/burst limits and reserves 16 of 64 slots for Protection/Settlement/Gateway/Outbox; concurrent admission cannot oversubscribe limits.
acceptance_mapping.circuit_breaker: Dependency failures deterministically open the circuit, deny calls during timeout, admit only bounded half-open probes and close only after success.
acceptance_mapping.backup_restore_disaster_drill: The executable isolated-cluster drill performs actual pg_basebackup, continuous WAL archive and transaction-target PITR, verifies manifest/schema/retained/excluded commands, performs explicit empty-state reconciliations and never touches an existing database.
acceptance_mapping.rpo_rto: Policy fixes accepted local command RPO=0, database disaster RPO<=300 seconds, restart RTO<=60 seconds and disaster RTO<=3600 seconds; recovery always begins PROTECT_ONLY and forbids old receipt reuse.
acceptance_mapping.runbooks: docs/V5-010-OPERATIONS-RUNBOOK.md defines SLOs, capacity, backup retention, five recovery gates and exercised response procedures for database loss, overload, connector failure, ledger/protection failure and missing/breached SLO data.

limitations: The PITR drill uses an explicit empty trading state; non-empty business recovery is separately proven by deterministic V2 fault/replay tests.
Synthetic breach samples prove alert behavior, not 30-day sim-prod SLO compliance. V5-011 must collect real continuous measurements and cannot reuse this drill as a substitute.
All runtime and recovery authority remains research/simulation-only; recovery never enables real order routing.
model_output_not_authoritative: Capacity, circuit, SLO and recovery decisions are deterministic policy outcomes; human gates remain required to leave PROTECT_ONLY/HALTED.
